name: Hindustan Motors Limited
summary: Hindustan Agrigenetics Ltd. engages in the business of development, production, and marketing of seeds, tissue culture, and floriculture. The firm’s main product is developing sunflower hybrid seed. It is also involved in the process of identifying and developing products based on digital technology to provide information on the needs of farmers. The company was founded on July 25, 1990 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
